title: Find the add-person path in every mode
when: A new teammate needs initial access
need: Use the mode-appropriate invitation/account and machine admission route; do not give someone else an own-machine code or infer authority from an existing token.
disclosure: Registered invite form fact before choosing an invite form; one-time code guidance after creation.
surface: teammate_invites.list reports email/yoke_account for hosted mode, email/company_sign_in for self-host with complete OIDC, name/invite_code for self-host without OIDC, and local/local for a local universe. Partial self-host OIDC refuses with operator recovery.
gap: The additive registry and atomic store are present. Human CLI redemption and Team navigation are separate, unfinished teaching surfaces; see gap teammate-invite-human-route.
review: Disposable-database tests cover form selection, org-admin authority, refusal guidance and secret replay/debug protection; deployed human-route proof remains open.
